summary: Project now needs a simple password-based admin access flow so the user can log in and manage a food menu (items with image and price).
architectural_notes: User requested replacing/adding to Internet Identity auth with a simple shared admin password login for admin panel access.
known_issues: Admin panel currently prompts for an 'admin token' and the user cannot access admin functions.

existing_features.title: Implement a simple password-based admin unlock so the user can access the admin dashboard and manage menu items (including image upload and price) using the password "admin 9828".

Update the admin access screen copy to use clear English and reflect password-based access: replace "Admin Token" wording with "Admin Password" and ensure the call-to-action explains that the password is required to access the admin dashboard.

Ensure the password entry flow integrates with the existing session-based secret storage so that after password submission the actor is re-initialized and admin status is rechecked automatically without requiring the user to edit the URL manually.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add simple password-based admin login (instead of/alongside Internet Identity) to access admin panel
Admin panel feature to manage menu items including food item image upload and price fields

projectName: Add simple password-based admin access to unblock menu management
